fitting.modeAggregation: component-wise median of recording means, then unit-sum normalization
fitting.recordAggregation: unweighted mean of tonic-aligned current-compressed usable segments
fitting.selection: prespecified two candidates; no grid search

dataset.title: GiantSteps+ v2
dataset.creator: Ángel Faraldo
dataset.citationRequestedByDataset: Ángel Faraldo (2017). Tonality Estimation in Electronic Dance Music: A Computational and Musically Informed Examination. PhD Thesis. Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Barcelona.
dataset.licenseEvidence: Official record metadata verified in docs/briefs/0003-free-key-benchmark/datasets.md; recordings originate from Beatport previews.

eligibility: Singleton consistent major/minor across valid ordered nonoverlapping regions within [0,120]; major/ionian and minor/aeolian/harmonic/melodic accepted. No confidence threshold.

partition.limitations: Primary artist is first comma-delimited name in filename credit before ' - ' after source ID, NFKC/casefold/whitespace normalized; ampersands remain intact. Full artist credit is retained. Aliases, differently credited collaborations, versions with different IDs and hashes are not resolved. Proportions are approximate by artist groups, not exact recording counts. Public model training overlap is unknown.
partition.method: SHA256(seed + NUL + sorted normalized artist credits), modulo 100; connected duplicates/source IDs

scope: Only the two native key-profile arrays changed. Existing adaptive compression, extraction, temporal voting and confidence formula remain unchanged.
limitations: EDM-specific problematic public previews; not broad music accuracy or current Mixed In Key parity.
Only 24 major-mode development recordings versus 206 minor-mode recordings.
Published human annotations preserve uncertainty; eligible labels require a consistent major/minor key.
Training uses development only. Validation selected between two prespecified candidates; reserved test is not used for fitting or selection.
Conservative artist grouping cannot resolve all aliases or remix/recording relationships.
No source audio is included in this provenance or app bundles; retain upstream attribution and license information.
